leaders.does: Many distortion styles in bands, with a live display and modulation
Five analog styles, one big Drive, a Punish switch, a mix and tone

picture.note: One cycle of a model wave before and after, not the signal: the kit has no live signal yet.

precision.note: Every setting is a kit value.

compare.note: Undo, redo and A/B from the kit.

explains.note: Every setting has an about; help adds ranges.

character.note: The house look; the wave turns purple with Drive and Mix.

presets.note: Three of its own, kept in the editor's storage, not as files.
